_readme: Single source of truth for paid sponsors. Add an entry only after Stripe shows the subscription active and paid. Then run: python3 _tools/post_sponsors.py --push

_fields.name: Business name as it should appear
_fields.category: e.g. property management, movers, renters insurance (lowercase)
_fields.featured_page: featured and founding only: page that gets the featured spot, e.g. dublin.html
_fields.blurb: optional, one or two sentences, max 240 characters
_fields.status: active | ended (ended entries are kept for records but not shown)
